sentences.text: Professional Visualization revenue for fiscal year 2024 was $1.6 billion, up 1% from fiscal year 2023.

In Professional Visualization, we announced new GPUs based on the NVIDIA RTX Ada Lovelace architecture, and announced NVIDIA Omniverse Cloud, a fully managed service running in Microsoft Azure, for the development and deployment of industrial metaverse applications.
Data Center net revenue of $12.6 billion in 2024 increased by 94%, compared to net revenue of $6.5 billion in 2023.
The increase was primarily driven by higher sales of AMD Instinct GPUs and AMD EPYC CPUs.
Data Center operating income was $3.5 billion in 2024, compared to operating income of $1.3 billion in 2023.
